# False-join variants against external, non-LLM signals

Generated by `crates/bench/scripts/falsejoin_validity.py external`. Signals: bibliographic coupling and co-citation from OpenAlex `referenced_works` (arXiv papers), shared LCSH headings (3,000 books). Pair samples: `pairs-<signal>.jsonl.gz` and their `.meta.json`. Method: `agreement.json` `method`. Brackets: 95% percentile bootstrap (1000 replicates for ρ and separation, 200 for pair-level AUC and κ); Δ is the variant minus Dasgupta on the same replicate. Pair-level agreement is computed on the minilm graph; scheme-level ρ on each graph.
